description: Bring back objects the user deleted, up to 200 object_ids in one call: the undo for delete_graph_object and delete_selected_graph_objects. Only the user's own deleted objects come back. A record that was merged into another is not restored here; unmerge_graph_objects undoes a merge. Permanently purged objects are gone and cannot be restored.
name: restore_graph_objects
title: Restore deleted brain objects
